entities.summary: D'or Anthony Naheem Fischer is an American-Israeli professional basketball who last played for Elitzur Eito Ashkelon of the Israeli National League. He has also represented the senior Israeli national team. Standing at 2.11 m, he plays at the power forward and center positions.
